Subject: Clarification on Expense Report Process

Dear Team,

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to provide clarity on the routine process for submitting expense reports. Please ensure that you follow the following steps to ensure your expenses are processed accurately and efficiently:

1. Gather all receipts and organize them by date and category.
2. Complete the expense report form, detailing the purpose of the expense and attaching all relevant documents.
3. Submit the report via the designated portal no later than the 15th of each month.
4. Follow up with the finance team if you encounter any issues or have any questions.

Your prompt adherence to this process will significantly aid in streamlining our financial operations. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or require further assistance.

Best regards,
